$comment: Facet motion tokens, single source for the WASM workbench and the panels (README 'Motion tokens'). From Facet main packages/tokens/src/tokens.json motion (durations, easings, transition) + how @facet/ui uses them (pickers.ts bottom sheet, toast.ts, device.ts rise, controls.ts dial sweep, 10-components.css press / toggle transitions, prefers-reduced-motion rules). tools/gen_motion.mjs -> motion_gen.h (fw::mo::). Offsets: v = 720 px panels, 1x = 480 (on the 4 px grid). Rule from the docs: animate opacity and transform (position) of small things only, so it holds on the panels.

groups.label: Interaction
groups.about: Feedback and transitions people wait on: short, ease-out (fast start, soft landing).

groups.label: Ambient
groups.about: Loops and clock motion nobody waits on: long, linear or ease-in-out. Off with reduced motion.

groups.label: Timing
groups.about: How long something stays, not an animation.

press.use: press and release colour fades, toggle knob

clock-hand.use: clock hand moving to a new minute

dial-sweep.use: value change: a dial or number sweeping to the new value

ripple.use: a ripple from a point: a new lightning strike's ring grows and fades (docs radar.ts flash 600 ms ease-out)

nudge-wait.use: - / + on a dial (Thermostat): more taps within this long are one change, then it goes out (docs 800)

wx-rays.use: weather icon: sun rays, one full turn

wx-drift.use: weather icon: front cloud drift, one way (there and back = 2x)

wx-drift-back.use: weather icon: back cloud drift, one way

wx-rain.use: weather icon: one rain drop falling

wx-rain-heavy.use: weather icon: one heavy rain drop falling

wx-snow.use: weather icon: one snow flake drifting down

wx-hail.use: weather icon: one hailstone falling and bouncing

wx-flash.use: weather icon: lightning, two flashes per cycle

wx-fog.use: weather icon: fog line slide, one way

wx-wind.use: weather icon: wind line slide, one way

hold-confirm.use: hold to confirm (Door lock unlock / open): the ring fills over this long; let go early and nothing happens (panel lab HOLD_MS 1200)

busy-turn.use: a short arc turning round a ring while a device works (Door lock locking / unlocking; panel lab 1 s linear)

toast-life-urgent.use: an urgent toast stays this long (someone at the door; layout.json toast life-urgent)

tick-min.use: step ticks (slider, dial, arc): audible ticks never closer than this; slow drags tick every step, fast drags thin out (26 -> 40 ms, Darren 2026-10-22)

demo-reset.use: docs site + workbench samples: a demo sample returns to its initial state this long after the last interaction (timer starts on release; the revert is silent: no sound, no event) (Darren 2026-10-22)

sport-glide-max.use: Sport: a car glides along the track for the time since the last feed update, at most this long (a slower or stalled feed jumps instead of crawling)

sport-moment.use: Sport: how long a moment stays marked (overtake tags, a point / goal emphasis)

sport-flash.use: Sport: a score that changes lifts in (new digits rise into place), a moment ring fades

sport-glide-step.use: Sport, lite (480 build): cars move in steps this long between feed updates (25 a second), so a frame only redraws when a car actually moved

ease-out.use: everything people trigger: press, sheets, toasts, rise, value sweeps

ease-in-out.use: ambient loops that go back and forth (pulse, mascot)

scrim.use: sheet scrim, dark theme: colour.json scrim at this opacity over the screen (was bg at 0.72; Darren 2026-10-22: the backdrop must read clearly darker)

scrim-light.use: sheet scrim, light theme: colour.json scrim (near-black) at this opacity, so the screen behind dims instead of washing out

pulse-min.use: pulse: the faintest point of a breath

reduced.about: Reduced motion (one global setting, off by default; per panel). Nothing moves: positions, rotations and value sweeps jump to the end; opacity fades stay, kept short; colour feedback (press) stays as it is; loops stop on their resting frame. From the docs: prefers-reduced-motion stops animations, the dial jumps, nothing spins, the state still follows.

modes.keep: unchanged (colour or opacity only, nothing moves)
modes.fade: opacity only, no movement, at the fade duration or shorter

press.label: Press
press.animates: fill, border, label and icon colour to the pressed look

release.label: Release
release.animates: colours back to the resting (or active) look
release.use: finger up, or the press slid off

toggle.label: Toggle
toggle.animates: knob slides across, track colour to accent

fade.label: Fade
fade.use: something appearing or leaving in place: loading to content, a badge

sheet-open.label: Sheet open
sheet-open.animates: scrim fades in; panel fades in and rises by the offset

sheet-close.label: Sheet close
sheet-close.animates: scrim fades out; panel fades out and drops by the offset

toast-in.label: Toast in
toast-in.animates: toast fades in and slides from the screen edge by the offset

toast-out.label: Toast out
toast-out.animates: toast fades out and slides back to the edge (a swipe: sideways by 160)

screen.label: Screen transition (content rise)
screen.animates: cut to the new screen (the old one goes at once), then its blocks, grouped into rows by their top (side by side = one row), fade in and rise by the offset: header first, each row a stagger later, at most max-steps steps (later rows share the last delay), hidden until they start; back to Home they drop in from above
screen.use: open a screen, back to Home (= Facet motion.transition.rise, the old lab's Content rise, Darren's pick facet-6; instant = option for slow boards)

value.label: Value change
value.animates: the shown number and its arc / bar sweep from the old value to the new one
value.use: dials, thermostat, counters, a new reading

clock-hand.label: Clock hand
clock-hand.animates: the hand turns to the new minute

ripple.label: Ripple
ripple.animates: a small ring at a point grows to 6x (its stroke with it) and fades to 0, once
ripple.use: a new event at a place: a lightning strike on the radar (Darren 2026-10-22: the docs ripple, softer than a flash)

pulse.label: Pulse
pulse.animates: opacity breathes from 100 % to opacity.pulse-min and back, forever

weather.label: Weather icon
weather.animates: a few small parts of the icon: rays turn, clouds drift 1-2 units, drops / snow / hail fall and fade, the bolt flashes, fog / wind lines slide, stars twinkle (keyframes per part: weather)
weather.use: weather icons on the Home card and the Weather hero (reduced = the static master)

weather.$comment: Animated weather icons: keyframes per part, from Facet main packages/icons/weather.css 1:1 (transform + opacity on small parts). Applied to the parts tools/gen_icons.mjs cuts from the masters (class fwx-<class>); `icons` = only in these icons (rain-heavy's faster drops). keys: [percent, {x, y (48-grid units), rot (deg), opa (0-1)}]; a prop missing at 0 / 100 % is its rest value (0, opacity 1), like CSS. loop repeat = 0 -> 100 % again, alternate = there and back (each way = the duration). stagger = instance i (the master's --i) starts i x stagger ms further on (CSS negative delay). Runtime (core/icons.cpp fw::weather_icon): one lv_anim clock per icon; a part is written only when its whole-px position, rotation step or opacity step changes (opa-step, rot-px), so a slow drift repaints a few times a second.

opa-step.use: opacity is written in steps of this (0-255): a star fading over 1.6 s repaints ~15 times, not every frame

rot-px.use: the rays turn in steps that move a ray tip this many px (hero 144: ~1 deg, ~14 repaints/s; card 72: ~7/s)
